notes: The Atticus surface emits structured follow-up questions, not answers, and never includes a self-reported confidence float. P1.5 elicitation is therefore architecturally un-parseable on this surface; coverage_label MUST be 'coverage-not-scored' (not raw 0).
The reference-well-behaved surface is included as a side-by-side shape check: same corpus, alternative surface behavior, measured cell.
Live Atticus scan is NOT touched by this dry-run.
